# Core Summary
This 15-second Guochao (China Chic) music video blends traditional Chinese aesthetics with cyberpunk futurism, structured as a four-shot progression. [Shot 1] opens with a dreamy close-up of a woman with Chinese makeup amidst floating particles. [Cut to] [Shot 2] shifts to a cyber-red tone featuring the same woman with glowing headphones and a coiling golden dragon. [Cut to] [Shot 3] expands to a wide stage view of four dancers in modified Qipao performing synchronized moves. [Cut to] [Shot 4] concludes with a dramatic logo reveal of "Bloom-Boom" in red metallic text.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:03] A soft, ethereal void background with floating transparent silk ribbons and holographic electronic flowers blooming in pastel hues. Lighting is diffuse and high-key, creating a dreamlike atmosphere with volumetric dust motes.
[shot2][00:04-00:07] The environment shifts to a deep cyber-red digital space. Background features abstract data streams and neon grid lines fading into darkness. Lighting is dramatic, dominated by red rim light and the glow from the headphones and dragon.
[shot3][00:08-00:12] A circular neon stage set in a futuristic cyber-city skyline at night. The stage floor is reflective black glass with glowing blue circuit patterns. Background shows towering holographic advertisements and mechanical structures. Lighting is dynamic, multicolor neon (pink, blue, purple) syncing with the beat.
[shot4][00:13-00:15] A pitch-black void with a single overhead spotlight casting a sharp cone of light onto the center. Dust particles float in the light beam. Lighting is high-contrast chiaroscuro, focusing solely on the text.

**Audio Description**:
[shot1] Ethereal synthesizer pad, soft and airy, with subtle wind chime textures.
[shot2] Music transitions to a rhythmic blend of traditional Pipa plucking and heavy electronic bass, tempo increases.
[shot3] Strong, driving beat with industrial percussion and synth leads, high energy.
[shot4] Music fades out quickly with a reverberating bass tail and a subtle metallic hum.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>: Female, East Asian, young adult. Delicate Chinese traditional makeup with red floral patterns near eyes, sleek black hair styled in a modern bun. Wears a futuristic white outfit with traditional collar elements in Shot 1; adds modern red glowing headphones in Shot 2.
<ID_B>: CGI Golden Dragon. Massive, serpentine body made of flowing light streams and gold scales. Translucent and glowing, moving with fluid snake-like motion.
<ID_Group>: Four female dancers, East Asian, young adults. Wearing matching modified Qipao dresses (black with neon trim). Athletic build, hair tied back.
**Vocal Characteristics**: No dialogue. Music drives the audio landscape.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Close-up on <ID_A>'s face, centered in frame, eyes closed in meditation. Her skin shimmers with tiny starlight particles that drift off her cheeks. Transparent silk ribbons float slowly around her head, weaving through holographic flowers that bloom and fade. Camera slowly pushes in (Dolly In). Sound of soft wind and ethereal synth swells.

[shot2][00:04-00:07] Medium shot of <ID_A>, now wearing red glowing headphones, eyes open and looking forward confidently. <ID_B> (Golden Dragon) coils rapidly around her right side, its head hovering near her shoulder. The lighting shifts sharply to intense red. <ID_A> tilts her head slightly to the rhythm. Camera orbits slightly right (Arc Shot). Pipa strings pluck sharply in sync with the dragon's movement.

[shot3][00:08-00:12] Wide shot of <ID_Group> on the circular stage, arranged in a diamond formation. They perform synchronized dance moves, combining classical Chinese hand gestures with sharp street dance isolations. Cyber mechanical arms in the background move in parallel with the dancers. Camera zooms out quickly then snaps back in (Crash Zoom) to match the beat. Heavy bass kicks as their feet strike the floor.

[shot4][00:13-00:15] Static shot of the dark background. The red metallic 3D text "Bloom-Boom" slams into the center under the spotlight, vibrating slightly upon impact. Light flares flicker around the text edges. Music cuts to silence with a lingering metallic resonance.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Visual style is "Guochao Cyberpunk," merging traditional Chinese elegance with high-tech neon aesthetics. Color palette transitions from soft pastels and gold (Shot 1) to intense cyber-red (Shot 2) to multicolor neon (Shot 3) and finally stark black and red (Shot 4). Lighting emphasizes volumetric fog, specular highlights on skin and metal, and glowing emissive materials. Textures should feel polished, combining organic silk with hard-surface tech.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
The clip evolves from mystical and serene to aggressive and energetic, ending on a bold, branded note. The atmosphere is immersive and high-energy, designed to captivate immediately with visual spectacle and rhythmic synchronization.
